propositions: DC outbound status is submitted as a field edit via issue.update(fields=...) instead of being routed through transition_issue_by_name, causing status changes to be silently rejected by Jira
Cloud transport (JiraCloudTransport) pops status from kwargs and routes it to transition_issue, but DC transport (JiraDataCenterTransport) does not perform this routing
update_issue must extract status from kwargs and call route_status_to_transition before passing remaining fields to issue.update
Illegal transitions that cannot be reached from the current workflow state must be non-fatal, recorded as bridge alerts, and not abort the entire batch
Multiple fields including status and editable fields like assignee must be applied in a single update_issue call without interference
